verses.en: Now I Paul myself beseech you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ, who in presence am base among you, but being absent am bold toward you:
verses.sm: O le pule a Paulo, ma lona uiga Paulo, o lē faamaulalo pe a aʻu i ai ia te outou, a e faamalosi pe a ou le i ai ia te outou, ou te aioi atu ia te outou ona o le agamalu ma le alofa o Keriso;

verses.en: But I beseech you, that I may not be bold when I am present with that confidence, wherewith I think to be bold against some, which think of us as if we walked according to the flesh.
verses.sm: ou te ole atu lava ina neʻi ou fai faamalosi pe a ou i ai ia te outou, ma le faamalosi ou te, manatu e matua faamalosi atu ai i nisi, o e manatunatu ia te i matou peiseai ua matou savavali faaletino.

verses.en: For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh:
verses.sm: Aua e ui lava ina matou savavali i le tino, matou te le tau faaletino;

verses.en: (For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;)
verses.sm: aua o auupega a lo matou nei taua e le faaletino ia, a e faamalolosia e le Atua e lepetia ai ‘olo;

verses.en: Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ;
verses.sm: o loo lepeti i lalo masalosaloga, ma mea maualuluga uma ua faasiasia i le iloa o le Atua, o loo faatoilaloina manatu uma ia anaana ia Keriso;

verses.en: And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.
verses.sm: o loo nofo sauni foi i matou e taui atu i le le anaana uma, pe a faaatoatoaina lo outou anaana.

verses.en: Do ye look on things after the outward appearance? If any man trust to himself that he is Christ's, let him of himself think this again, that, as he is Christ's, even so are we Christ's.
verses.sm: Ia vaavaai i mea ua faafesagai ma outou. Afai e taofi se tasi o ia o le sa Kerisó, seʻi toe manatu ifo ia, e pei o ia o lo sa Kerisó, e faapea foi i matou o sa Kerisó.

verses.en: For though I should boast somewhat more of our authority, which the Lord hath given us for edification, and not for your destruction, I should not be ashamed:
verses.sm: Aua e ui lava ina faatele ane teisi loʻu mitamita i le pule o ia te i matou, ua foaiina mai ia te i matou e le Alii e ati ae, a e le ina ia lepetia outou, Ou te le ma ai;

verses.en: That I may not seem as if I would terrify you by letters.
verses.sm: ina neʻi peiseai ou te faamatau ia te outou i tusi. to Au?

verses.en: For his letters, say they, are weighty and powerful; but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech contemptible.
verses.sm: ua faapea a nisi, “O ana tusi e mamafa ma malolosi ia; a o lona tino pe a nofo mai e vaivai lea, ma lana upu e faatauvaa lea.”

verses.en: Let such an one think this, that, such as we are in word by letters when we are absent, such will we be also in deed when we are present.
verses.sm: Ia manatua lenei mea e lea tagata, O le mea ua matou tusi atu ai ina o matou le i ai, o lea lava le mea matou te faia a o matou i ai.

verses.en: For we dare not make ourselves of the number, or compare ourselves with some that commend themselves: but they measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise.
verses.sm: Aua maiou te le faamalosi ina faatasia, pe faatusatusaina ai matou ma nisi, O e vivii i latou ia te i latou; a o i latou, o loo fefuafuai i latou ia te i latou, ma fefaatusatusai i latou ia te i latou, e le popoto i latou.

verses.en: But we will not boast of things without our measure, but according to the measure of the rule which God hath distributed to us, a measure to reach even unto you.
verses.sm: A E matou te le mitamita i mea ua le fuatia mai, a e peitai e tusa i le fua o le mataàgaluega ua tofia mai e le Atua ia te i matou, o le fua e oo atu lava ia te outou.

verses.en: For we stretch not ourselves beyond our measure, as though we reached not unto you: for we are come as far as to you also in preaching the gospel of Christ:
verses.sm: Aua matou te le fua faasili, peiseai ua matou le oo atu ia te outou, a ua muamua matou i le oo atu lava ia te sutou ma le tala lelei a Keriso.

verses.en: Not boasting of things without our measure, that is, of other men's labours; but having hope, when your faith is increased, that we shall be enlarged by you according to our rule abundantly,
verses.sm: O loo matou le mitamita i mea ua le: fuatia mai, o galuega ia a isi tagata; a o loo faamoemoe i matou e faateleina ia te outou la matou matagaluega, e atili ai pe a tupu lo outou faatuatua,

verses.en: To preach the gospel in the regions beyond you, and not to boast in another man's line of things made ready to our hand.
verses.sm: matou te folafola atu ai le tala lelei i nuu i tala atu © outou, o loo le mitamita i le matagaluega a le tasi tagata ua uma ona saunia.

verses.en: But he that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.
verses.sm: A o le mitamita, ia mitamita o ia i le Alii.

verses.en: For not he that commendeth himself is approved, but whom the Lord commendeth.
verses.sm: Auā e le talia o le ua vivii o ia ia te ia, a o le ua viia e le Alii.
